title: Small Edits, Shifting Decisions: Benchmarking LLM Accuracy and Reliability on French Input Variants
abstract: arXiv:2610.33493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: French users may omit apostrophes and diacritics or make keyboard typos in everyday input. The effects of these common variations on language model performance and prediction reliability remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we construct a controlled French surface-variant benchmark covering seven task types, with 4,200 original-low-high triplets (12,600 input instances). Each high-intensity variant retains all low-intensity edits and adds further changes. We evaluate six models from two LLM families. The results show that accuracy decreases and Brier score and negative log-likelihood (NLL) increase with perturbation intensity. Larger models show smaller accuracy losses under high intensity, but increases in Brier score and NLL do not consistently decrease with scale. translated_title: 微小改动，决策改变：基于法语输入变体的大语言模型准确性与可靠性基准测试
translated_abstract: 法语用户在日常输入中可能会省略撇号和变音符号，或出现键盘打字错误。这些常见变体对语言模型性能和预测可靠性的影响尚缺乏充分理解。为填补这一空白，我们构建了一个受控的法语表层变体基准，涵盖七种任务类型，包含4,200组“原文-低强度-高强度”三元组（共12,600个输入实例）。每个高强度变体保留所有低强度编辑，并添加进一步的变化。我们评估了来自两个大语言模型家族的六个模型。结果表明，随着扰动强度的增加，准确率下降，Brier分数和负对数似然（NLL）上升。更大的模型在高强度扰动下准确率损失较小，但Brier分数和NLL的增加并不随模型规模的增大而持续下降。在预设的高强度设置下，键盘打字错误导致准确率和预测概率质量的最大损失。最后，校准（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了一个包含12,600个输入实例、涵盖七种任务类型的法语表层变体基准，系统评估发现撇号省略、变音符号缺失和键盘错字等常见输入扰动会显著降低大语言模型的准确率与预测概率可靠性，而更大的模型规模仅能部分缓解这一问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a controlled French surface-variant benchmark with 12,600 input instances across seven task types, showing that common perturbations like omitted apostrophes, missing diacritics, and keyboard typos significantly degrade LLM accuracy and prediction reliability, with larger model scale only partially mitigating these effects.
